title: Battle of Imphal 1944
heroSubtitle: From museum spaces to journeys through Northeast India’s wartime past.
bioTitle:
A lifelong curiosity.
A story still unfolding.
bioParagraphs: Some paths begin with a profession and quietly evolve into a life’s calling. A civil engineer by training, he brings technical precision and thoughtful craftsmanship to building and restoring museum spaces—creating environments where memory and heritage truly resonate.

Yet his dedication reaches well beyond exhibition galleries. You will often find him tracing forgotten mountain trails, documenting wartime relics, and sitting with local communities to listen to the living histories they carry. Across Manipur and Arunachal Pradesh, his field research preserves overlooked chapters of the past, while his guided battlefield walks through Manipur and Kohima bring travelers closer to the region’s profound historical ties with Japan.

Curiosity anchors everything he undertakes. Currently deepening his craft through university museology studies, he collaborates closely with emerging preservationists. Every quiet trail, preserved artifact, and shared oral history invites another meaningful conversation—bridging the gap between the echoes of yesterday and today.
